_comment: Mutation kill-rate thresholds, read by BOTH gate scripts: src/release/check_mutation_gate.py
(mutmut, over src/hooks/) and src/release/checkMutationGate.mts (Stryker, over src/builder/ +
src/release/ + src/metrics/). Single-sourced on purpose — two runtimes each hardcoding 90/95 is
exactly how the two gates drift apart, and a project that gates itself at >= 90% must not have two
answers to what 90 means. src/release/tests/pipeline/mutationGate.spec.ts and src/release/tests/
test_mutation_gate.py both read this file, so a change here moves both gates or fails both suites.
